items.item: The orders table starts in the first viewport; no KPI cards, hero or greeting above it
items.evidence: Audit firstTableTop=247 at 900px height; screenshot shows breadcrumb, h1, tabs, filter row, then table. No KPI/hero/greeting.

items.item: Page header has a plural title and exactly one primary action (create order)
items.evidence: h1 'Đơn hàng' (Vietnamese has no plural inflection; names the collection). Only #btnCreate 'Tạo đơn hàng' is filled blue-700; 'Nhập' and 'Xuất' are outlined secondary. Audit headerPrimaryActions=1.

items.item: 2–3 filters are visible; applied filters show as removable chips with a clear-all control
items.evidence: Visible: search #q, select #fChannel, select #fOwner (plus 'Bộ lọc khác' panel). renderChips() builds chips with button[data-chip] aria-label 'Gỡ bộ lọc …' and #clearAll 'Xóa tất cả'.

items.item: Status tabs or saved views show counts
items.evidence: renderTabs(): 'Tất cả 120, Nháp 7, Chờ xác nhận 11, Đang xử lý 22, Đang giao 13, Hoàn thành 55, Đã hủy 12' visible in screenshot.

items.item: Bulk selection has a header checkbox with an indeterminate state and a bulk bar showing the selected count
items.evidence: #hdrCb with cb.indeterminate = some && !pageSel in renderHead(); #bulkBar with #bulkCount 'Đã chọn N đơn'.

items.item: When results span pages, the user can select all matching results, not just the visible page
items.evidence: renderBulk(): when page is fully selected and total > rows.length, #bulkAll shows 'Chọn tất cả N đơn khớp'; sets sel.all and targetOrders() uses filtered().

items.item: Amounts are right-aligned with tabular figures and locale currency formatting; dates are absolute
items.evidence: Total cells 'text-right tabular-nums' via fmtAmt (Intl vi-VN, e.g. 7.777.000); column header carries unit 'Tổng tiền (VND)'; summary uses fmtMoney (NF_VND, 4.784.707.000 ₫). Dates absolute 'dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm' in time[datetime]. Audit numeric cells misaligned 0, nonTabular 0. Minor defect: the Total column header is not right-aligned (audit numeric-align error; inline-flex button inside th).

items.item: Filtering to zero results shows a no-results state with a way to clear filters, distinct from the first-use empty state
items.evidence: render(): f.length===0 branch -> stateRow('filterx','Không có đơn hàng nào khớp …', button data-act=clear-filters 'Xóa bộ lọc'); first-use branch (data.length===0) is separate 'Chưa có đơn hàng nào' with 'Tạo đơn hàng' CTA (reachable via ?state=empty).

items.item: Row actions show at most two visible controls; icon-only controls have accessible names
items.evidence: rowHtml(): text button 'Sửa' (aria-label 'Sửa đơn ID') + icon button data-more aria-label 'Thao tác cho đơn ID'; rest in menu (view, duplicate, print, cancel). Audit icon-button-name no violations.

items.item: A destructive bulk action (cancel orders) asks for confirmation naming the count and the consequence
items.evidence: Bulk 'Khác' menu -> 'Hủy đơn' -> runBulk('cancel') -> confirmDlg title `Hủy ${n} đơn hàng?`, body 'Đơn đã hủy không thể mở lại.' (plus paid-order warning), buttons 'Giữ đơn' / `Hủy ${n} đơn`, danger style, alertdialog with Escape/focus handling.

notes: No template tells found: no greeting, KPI tiles, gradients, glass, uppercase tracking, emoji icons, promo card, charts, hover-lift or oversized radii (radii 4 and 6px). Sidebar is light slate with a single blue accent; status badges use a restrained semantic tone set (neutral/info/success/warning/danger), not rainbow. The 'LH' avatar is the signed-in person's initials, so it is not a non-person avatar. Audit score 90 with one error: Total column header not right-aligned (visible in screenshot, header wraps to two lines and sits centered). Other minor issues: header cells 'Mã đơn' and 'Tổng tiền (VND)' wrap to two lines; some customer names wrap to two lines (8 double-line rows). The destructive cancel is buried under 'Khác', which is acceptable. The status of banner/bulk flow, import and export are present.
